title: AbFlow : End-to-end Paratope-Centric Antibody Design by Interaction Enhanced Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2602.07084v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Antigen-antibody binding is a critical process in the immune response. Although recent progress has advanced antibody design, current methods lack a generative framework for end-to-end modeling of full-atom antibody structures and struggle to fully exploit antigen-specific geometric information for optimizing local binding interfaces and global structures. To overcome these limitations, we introduce AbFlow, a paratope-restricted one-step flow-matching framework for designing full-atom antibodies end-to-end. AbFlow incorporates an extended velocity field network featuring an equivariant Surface Multi-channel Encoder, which uses surface-level antigen interaction data to refine the antibody structure, particularly the CDR-H3 region. translated_title: AbFlow：基于相互作用增强流匹配的端到端互补位中心抗体设计
translated_abstract: 抗原-抗体结合是免疫应答中的一个关键过程。尽管近期的进展推动了抗体设计的发展，但现有方法缺乏能够对全原子抗体结构进行端到端建模的生成式框架，并且难以充分利用抗原特异性的几何信息来优化局部结合界面和全局结构。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了AbFlow，这是一个以互补位为约束的单步流匹配框架，用于端到端地设计全原子抗体。AbFlow引入了一个扩展的速度场网络，其中包含等变表面多通道编码器，该编码器利用表面层面的抗原相互作用数据来优化抗体结构，特别是CDR-H3区域。在以互补位为中心的抗体设计、多CDR及全原子抗体设计、结合亲和力优化以及复合物结构预测方面的广泛实验表明，AbFlow产生了优越的效果。
tldr: AbFlow提出了一个以互补位为约束的单步流匹配生成框架，通过等变表面多通道编码器利用抗原表面相互作用信息，首次实现了全原子抗体的端到端设计。
en_tdlr: AbFlow is a paratope-restricted one-step flow-matching framework that enables end-to-end full-atom antibody design by leveraging an equivariant Surface Multi-channel Encoder to exploit antigen surface-level interaction information.
